Due dates

Treasurer page: real and other property taxes due January 15 of the following year without penalty; 3% after Jan 15, additional 7% after Feb 1 (10% total), additional 5% after March 17 (15% total) and the bill goes to the Delinquent Tax Department.. See the official page.

Challenging your assessment

Written objection to the Assessor within 90 days after notices are mailed (30 days if specified on a notice); if no notice that year, by the last day to pay without penalty (typically Jan 15). Must be in writing with an original signature, mailed or hand-delivered (no email/fax); later stages have 30-day deadlines.. See the official page.

The Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey counts about 152,014 people in Charleston, which makes it the 1st largest of the 22 sc places we cover. The median value of an owner-occupied home is $469,100, 75% above the median of those 22 places. 56% of occupied homes are owner-occupied and 44% are rented, against a median of 66% owner-occupancy across the sc places. The median home was built in 1994, about 29 years ago, which matters for roofs, plumbing and inspection requests. These numbers describe Charleston as a whole, so a given street can sit well above or below them.
